svg.text: The path in order, all steps at once. Only the components and edges the journey touches

g.aria-label: Inbox, the decisions waiting for you, built
Steering, your PR comments, read back, planned
Architect, the planner that attacks the spec, built
Feedforward, what the agent is told before it starts, built
EngineerLoop, the inner loop around the agent, built
Pipeline, the decision per component, built
HumanCheckpoint, the pause before a merge, built
AutonomyLadder, how much the factory may do alone, built

svg.text: the number at the start of an edge is the step that traces it; a step nothing measures says so
You write the spec and, when the planner halts on a blocker, you fix the spec; there is no override flag.
You watch the board, drill into a component, and read the findings beside the transcript.
With the checkpoint on, the factory stops before each merge and shows you the diff, the findings and the cost;
you approve, reject or spend a retry.
Decisions the factory may not take alone wait for you in one place; you approve, reject, retry or snooze.
You promote the factory only with evidence and an acknowledgement; it demotes itself without asking.
Planned: your golden patterns and standing corrections are read on every run, and a comment on a pull request
